# Reply to a PR review

Internal procedure for an authorized PR comment or review reply.

1. Confirm posting authority, repository, PR and exact thread. Read its latest
   discussion. Drafting or reviewing a comment does not authorize posting it.
2. State the disposition: fixed, disagreed or deferred. Give concise code, commit
   or verification evidence. Apply [TLDR](../../tldr/SKILL.md), then
   [Unslop](../../unslop/SKILL.md). Skip empty agreement and routine status noise.
3. A "fixed" reply needs a verified remote commit containing the fix. Say when
   work is still local. Never invent test results or claim a human's approval.
4. Do not add a model signature or generated-by footer. Preserve human credit;
   surface a conflicting repository disclosure rule before posting.
5. Reply in the existing thread using the service's supported API or exact body
   file. After an uncertain result, check for an equivalent reply before retrying.
6. Resolve a thread only with authority and a supported disposition. A reply is
   not approval; a human request for changes stays open until the reviewer or
   repository process clears it.
7. Read back the published text and return its URL. Verify requested resolution
   separately. Preserve other people's comments unless editing is authorized.

Use [attachments](attachments.md) for visual evidence.
This procedure never authorizes merging, closing PRs or unrelated messages.
